lines.vo: Checking your inbox less often could make you less stressed.
That's not laziness. Every check is a tiny interruption.
Kev counts his check ins in his Break the Habit tracker.
lines.cap: Kev counts his check-ins in his Break the Habit tracker.

lines.vo: In one study, one hundred twenty four adults spent a week checking email just three times a day.
lines.cap: In one study, 124 adults spent a week checking email just 3 times a day.

lines.vo: Another week, they checked as often as they liked.
During the three times a day week, they reported lower daily stress.
lines.cap: During the 3-times-a-day week, they reported lower daily stress.

lines.vo: So batch it. Notifications off, inbox at set times.
Three checks, three boxes. That's how you stay on track.
lines.cap: 3 checks, 3 boxes. That's how you stay on track.
